DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 転入のご相談ですね。今回こちらへお越しになったのは、ご本人だけですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: You're consulting about moving in. Are you the only person who came today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 今日は私だけです。家族も一緒に引っ越しましたが、仕事で来られません。私が来れば全員分の手続きも必ず済むのかを先に聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 本人だけ来庁し同行転居家族は勤務のため全員分を必ず済ませられるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Only me today. Family moved together but cannot come because of work. First I want to know if my coming guarantees completing everyone's procedures.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you came alone, family who moved with you are working, and ask whether you can definitely finish everyone's procedures. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ご家族の分については、関係や書類、どの手続きをするかを担当が確認します。持っている書類を分けて見せていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: For family, staff must check relationships, documents and which procedures. Could you show the documents separately?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: これは私の在留カードで、こちらは前の役所の書類です。家族の確認書類は持っていないので、全部そろっているとは言えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 本人カードと前役所書類を示し家族確認書類は未持参で全部揃いとしないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: This is my residence card and these are the previous municipal office's documents. I don't have family identification, so can't say everything is ready.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show your card and former-office documents, explaining family verification documents weren't brought and you don't claim everything is complete. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ご本人分とご家族分を分けて確認しましょう。家族の名前や日付についても、不確かなまま申請書へ書き写さないようにしてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's check your part separately from your family's. Don't copy uncertain family names or dates into applications.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 氏名の表記を記憶だけで書かず、必要なものを聞いて本人に確認します。今日どこまで相談や申請ができるか、担当に整理してほしいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 氏名を記憶で書かず必要物と本人確認をし今日可能な相談申請範囲の整理を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I won't write names from memory; I'll ask what's needed and check with the people themselves. Please have staff organize what consultation or applications are possible today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you won't write names from memory, will check requirements and the people themselves, and request clarifying today's possible consultation and application scope. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 状況に応じて進められる範囲と不足するものをご案内します。住所のほかに、別の窓口へ聞きたいことはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: We'll explain what can proceed and what's missing according to circumstances. Besides address matters, anything to ask another counter?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 家族の保険についても相談先を知りたいです。住所の話をしただけで保険も全員分変更済みとは考えないよう、別に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 家族保険の相談先を尋ね住所相談だけで全員保険も変更済みと考えないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'd like to know where to discuss family insurance too. I'll check separately, without assuming an address discussion means everyone's insurance has changed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask where to consult on family insurance and say address consultation alone doesn't mean everyone's insurance is changed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 保険は確認先を分けてお伝えします。家族が後日来る必要がある場合の案内も、担当の回答を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll separately give the insurance contact. Also check staff's answer about whether family must come later.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日は本人分と家族分、住所と保険を混ぜずに聞きます。済んだものと未確認のものをメモし、家族には未確認の分も完了したとは伝えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 本人家族と住所保険を分け済んだ事と未確認を控え家族へ全完了と伝えないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Today I'll distinguish myself from family and address from insurance. I'll note completed versus unconfirmed matters and won't tell family that unchecked matters are done.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you'll separate self/family and address/insurance, record completed and unconfirmed matters and not tell family everything is done. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは持参書類の確認から担当へおつなぎします。ご家族分の可否はまだ決まっていません。こちらへどうぞ。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll connect you with staff starting with your documents. Whether your family's procedures can be done is not yet decided. This way, please. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 予約変更のご相談ですね。変更したい事情を教えていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: You're consulting about changing an appointment. Could you explain why?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 日本語を手伝ってくれる友人が来られなくなりました。友人の来られる日に予約を移せるか聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 日本語補助の友人が来られず来られる日へ予約を変えられるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: The friend who helps my Japanese can no longer come. Could I move the appointment to a day they can?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say the friend providing Japanese help can't come and ask to change to a day they can. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 支援の都合も含めて確認します。その前に、前回から症状や体調に変わったところはありませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: We'll consider support availability too. First, have symptoms or your condition changed since last time?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 同じような違和感ですが、感じる回数は前より増えています。付き添いの都合だけを伝えて、その変化を言い忘れるところでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 違和感は似ているが回数増加を忘れず予定都合と合わせ伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: The discomfort is similar but happens more often. I almost mentioned only the companion's schedule and forgot that change.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Report similar discomfort but increased frequency, remembering to mention it with the scheduling issue. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 回数が増えたという点を先に医師へ伝えます。ここで、友人の予定まで待ってよいとは判断できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll first tell the doctor about increased frequency. I can't decide here that it's okay to wait for your friend's availability.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 同じ症状だから延期してよいとは決めません。予約の日の相談と、回数が増えたことの相談を分けて、担当に聞いてほしいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 同症状だから延期可とせず日時と回数増加の相談を分け担当確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I won't decide postponement is fine just because symptoms are similar. Please ask staff separately about the appointment date and increased frequency.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Don't assume similar symptoms permit delay; request separate staff checks of date and increased frequency. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 医師への確認と、言語の支援についての案内をつなぎます。どのような手伝いがあると受診しやすいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: We'll connect the doctor check and language-support guidance. What assistance would make attending easier?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 早い説明を一度に聞くのが難しいです。友人がいない場合も、短く区切って話してもらい、日時や持ち物を文字で見られるか相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 友人不在でも短く区切る説明と日時持参物の文字確認を相談したいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: It's hard to hear fast explanations all at once. Even without my friend, I'd like to discuss short sections and seeing the date, time and items to bring in writing.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you want short-section explanations and written date/time and required items even without the friend. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その希望を伝えます。支援の可否や予約の扱いを確認してから、ご案内します。元の予約票はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll pass that on. After checking available support and appointment handling, we'll guide you. Have the original appointment slip?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: こちらです。新しい日時が決まったと思って元の票を捨てず、症状の変化と支援の回答を聞いてから予定を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 予約票を示し新日時確定と思って捨てず症状支援回答後に予定確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Here. I won't assume a new time is fixed and discard the original; I'll hear the answers on symptoms and support before checking plans.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Show the appointment slip, retain it without assuming a new time, and say you'll check plans after symptom/support answers. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では回数が増えたという情報を含め、医師へ確認します。まだ予約変更や延期可能という判断は出ていません。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then I'll check with the doctor, including increased frequency. Neither appointment change nor permission to postpone has been decided. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 自転車が見当たらないとのご相談ですね。どこで探されましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: You're asking about a missing bicycle. Where did you look?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 昨日停めた駐輪場を探しました。ただ、昨日は反対側の入口から入ったので、今日見た列が同じか、自信がなくなっています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 昨日と入口が違い今日探した列が駐輪列と同じか不確かと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I searched yesterday's parking area. But I entered from the opposite entrance yesterday, so I'm now unsure today's row was the same.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain yesterday's entrance differed and you are unsure today's searched row matches where you parked. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 停めたと思う位置と、今日探した範囲を分けて図に示していただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Could you separately mark where you think you parked and the area searched today on the diagram?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 昨日はこの入口から入り、奥の列へ進みました。今日は手前の列だけ見て、見つからなかったので、全部調べたとは言えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 昨日は奥列へ進み今日は手前のみで全体捜索済みでないと図示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I entered here yesterday and went to the rear row. Today I checked only the front row and didn't find it, so can't say I searched everything.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show yesterday's rear-row route and today's front-only search, not claiming the whole area was searched. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その範囲を記録します。管理者が移動した可能性も含め、管理者へは確認されていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll record that area. Have you checked with management, including possible relocation?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: まだです。移動されたとも盗まれたとも決めず、管理者の案内を確かめます。車体情報はこの書類を持っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 管理者未確認で移動盗難と断定せず車体書類を示し案内確認すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Not yet. Without deciding it was moved or stolen, I'll check their guidance. I have this document about the bicycle.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say management is unchecked, don't assert relocation or theft, show bicycle documents and decide to check management guidance. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。車体の特徴と登録の情報を担当が確認します。手元に書いた番号は、どの番号でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Thank you. Staff will check bicycle features and registration details. What number did you write here?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 最初にメモしたのは鍵の番号でした。防犯登録の番号と同じではないので、書類の見出しを見て、正しい欄を示したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: メモは鍵番号で防犯登録と違うため見出しで正しい書類欄を示したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: The first number I noted was the key number. It differs from the anti-theft registration number, so I'd like to read headings and show the right field.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say the note is a key number, not anti-theft registration, and you want to use headings to identify the correct field. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 番号の種類を分けて確認しましょう。鍵をかけたか、わからない場合も断定せずお話しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let's distinguish the number types. If unsure whether you locked it, don't assert that either.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 鍵を持っているのでかけたつもりでしたが、その動作をはっきり覚えていません。不確かな点として伝え、探した範囲と管理者の回答も後で知らせます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 鍵所持だけで施錠断定せず動作記憶不明を伝え捜索範囲と管理者回答も知らせると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I thought I had because I have the key, but don't clearly remember doing it. I'll report that uncertainty, and later the search area and management's reply too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Don't infer locking from possessing the key; report uncertain action memory and promise search-area and management updates. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では確実な点と不明な点を分け、担当へつなぎます。盗難や移動が確定した段階ではありません。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: We'll separate known and unknown points and connect you with staff. Theft or relocation is not established. Thank you for consulting.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 提出書類の発送ですね。記録についてのご希望はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: You're mailing submission documents. Any requirements about records?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 送った後に届いたことを確認したいです。追跡で配達完了になれば、提出先に受理された証明にもなると思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 追跡配達完了を提出先の受理証明とも思ったと発送前に相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want to check delivery afterward. I thought tracking marked delivered would also prove the recipient formally accepted my documents.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Before shipping, explain you thought tracking completion also proved the recipient's acceptance. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 配達の状況と、提出先が書類を受理したかは別です。郵便の記録だけで審査や受理まで確認できるとは案内できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Delivery status and the recipient accepting the documents are different. We can't say postal records verify examination or acceptance.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 届いたことと書類が受理されたことを分けます。先方の案内に「受領の記録を残す」とあるので、どの形の記録かも確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 配達と受理を分け受領記録という指定の形式も確認したいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'll distinguish delivery from acceptance. Their instructions say retain a receipt record, so I'd like to confirm what kind too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Separate delivery and acceptance and say you want to verify the specified receipt-record format. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その記録に求める内容は提出先へ確認してください。ご希望がわかれば、利用できる方法と料金を比べてご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Ask the recipient what that record must show. Once your requirements are known, we can compare available methods and prices.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ただ配達状況を見られればよいのか、受け取られた記録を別に示す必要があるのか、提出先に聞きます。サービス名を先に決めてしまわないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 追跡状況だけか別受領記録か提出先へ尋ねサービス名を先決しないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll ask whether just viewing tracking is enough or a separate receipt record is required. I won't choose a service name in advance.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you'll ask whether tracking alone or a separate receipt record is needed, without deciding the service first. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。書類はもう封をされていますか。控えについて提出先からの指示もありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. Have you sealed the documents? Any recipient instructions about copies?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: まだ封をしていません。自分の控えは作りましたが、原本を入れるのかコピーを入れるのかを最終確認してから封をしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 自分控えは作ったが未封で原本かコピーか最終確認後に封をすると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Not sealed. I've made my own copy, but want final confirmation whether to enclose originals or copies before sealing.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you made your own copy but haven't sealed, and will seal only after checking original versus copy. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 中に入れるものの指定は、ご自身で提出先に照合してください。窓口で内容の受理条件まで確定することはできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Match the required contents with the recipient yourself. This counter cannot establish their acceptance conditions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日は書類を持ち帰り、原本かコピーかと必要な受領記録を聞きます。発送時は控えも保管し、配達の確認後に受理の状況は先方へ別に尋ねます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 今日は持帰り原本コピーと受領記録を確認し発送控え保存と先方受理照会を別にすると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll take them home today and ask original versus copy and required receipt records. When sending I'll keep my copy, and after delivery ask them separately about acceptance.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you'll take documents home, check originals/copies and receipt records, retain shipping copies and separately inquire about recipient acceptance. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 本日は発送せず条件の確認までで承りました。書類をお忘れなく、またご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Today is conditions consultation without shipping. Don't forget your documents; consult us again.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 新しい口座についてのご相談ですね。何に使われる予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: You're asking about a new account. What is the intended use?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 給与を受け取るためです。会社の用紙の見本にこの銀行の名前があったので、必ずここで新しく作るものだと思って来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 給与用紙の銀行名を必須指定と思い新規口座相談に来たと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Salary. This bank's name appeared in the sample company form, so I thought I definitely had to open a new one here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you treated a salary-form bank name as mandatory and came about opening a new account. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 会社の用紙に書かれたことが、見本なのか指定なのかは確認されていますか。すでにお使いの口座はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Have you checked whether the company form shows an example or a requirement? Do you already use an account?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 別の銀行の自分の口座があります。今見ると用紙の下に「記入例」とあります。会社の指定かどうかを聞かず、銀行名だけで決めていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 他行本人口座があり記入例表示を会社確認せず指定と決めたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have my own at another bank. Now I see entry example below. I decided from the bank name without asking the company.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain another-bank account exists and you treated the example as mandatory without checking with the company. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 会社が求める振込先の条件は、会社へ確認してください。こちらで口座を作る場合も、ご本人の状況と書類の確認が必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Check the employer's destination-account conditions with them. Opening here also requires your circumstances and documents to be checked.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 会社に今の口座でよいかと、必要な口座の種類を聞きます。もし新規が必要なら、在留カードと勤務先資料のほかに何が必要かも相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 会社に既存口座可否と種類を聞き新規なら追加必要資料を銀行へ相談したいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll ask whether my current account is okay and what account type is needed. If a new one is required, I'd like advice on documents beyond residence card and employer materials.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you'll ask work about existing-account eligibility and type, and the bank about extra documents if a new account is needed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 資料の確認として担当へおつなぎできます。会社の希望だけで開設可や当日の完了を約束するものではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: I can refer you for document checking. The company's wish alone does not promise approval or completion today.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今日中にできると会社へ言わないでおきます。今は開設申込みを進めず、必要資料と手続きの流れの説明を先に聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 即日完了を会社へ約束せず今は申込まず必要資料と流れの説明を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I won't tell work it can be finished today. I won't proceed with an application now; first I want explanation of documents and process.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Don't promise same-day completion to work; request required-document and process explanation without applying now. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 説明の中で不明な用語があれば、そのまま署名せずお尋ねください。会社への質問もメモに分けられます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: If terms are unclear, ask instead of signing anyway. Questions for work can be noted separately too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 銀行へは本人確認と申込条件、会社へは既存口座の可否と給与用の条件を聞きます。記入例だけで選ばず、回答がそろってから申し込むか決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 銀行の本人申込条件と会社の既存口座給与条件を分け回答後に申込判断と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll ask the bank identity and application conditions, work about my existing account and salary conditions. I won't choose from the example alone; I'll decide after all answers.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Separate bank identity/application conditions from employer existing-account/salary conditions and say you'll decide after answers. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは本日は開設の事前相談として承ります。会社の指定は未確認として記録します。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Today we'll treat this as pre-opening consultation, recording employer requirements as unconfirmed. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: コーヒーの値札についてでしょうか。どの数字を確認したいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is this about the coffee price tag? Which number do you want to check?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 「二袋で」と書かれた価格を、一袋の値段だと思っていました。今日は一袋だけ必要なので、その場合の価格を知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 二袋価格を一袋と思い今日は一袋だけの価格を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I mistook the two-bag price for one bag. I only need one today, so want that price.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you mistook a two-bag price for one and ask today's one-bag price. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この表示は対象の二袋を組み合わせる場合のものです。一袋の価格は別の札にあります。お持ちの味はこちらですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: This display applies to combining two eligible bags. One-bag price is another tag. This is your flavor, right?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この味です。隣に違う味もありますが、どれでも二袋なら同じ条件なのかは、表示だけでは読み取れません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 持参味を示し隣の別味も二袋条件に含むか不明と確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: This flavor. There's another beside it, but I can't tell from the display whether any two flavors qualify.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show your flavor and check whether the neighboring flavor is included in the two-bag conditions. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 対象はこちらに書かれた品名です。隣の味はこの組合せの対象に含まれていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Eligible product names are written here. The neighboring flavor is not included in this combination.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 似た袋でも全部対象ではないのですね。二袋分を無理に買わず、今持っている味の一袋の税込み価格で考えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 似た袋全部対象でないと理解し二袋無理買いせず一袋税込みで検討すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: So similar bags aren't all eligible. I won't force myself to buy two; I'll consider the tax-included price for one of this flavor.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Understand similar bags aren't all eligible, and consider one bag's tax-included price without forcing two. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 一袋の税込み表示はこちらです。まとめ買いの価格ではない方で、お確かめください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Here is the tax-included one-bag display. Check this rather than the bulk-buy price.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 必要量は一袋なので、その価格で一つにします。レジで二袋割引が付かなくても、表示どおりなら間違いだとは言わないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 必要量一袋を選び表示どおりなら二袋割引なしを誤りとしないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I need one, so I'll choose one at that price. If the till has no two-bag discount but follows this display, I won't call it an error.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Choose one needed bag and say no two-bag discount isn't an error if the displayed price is followed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらの味を一袋ですね。会計の品名と個数もご確認いただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: One bag of this flavor, understood. You can check product name and quantity at checkout too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 味が合い、個数は一袋だと確認して会計へ持って行きます。買わない隣の袋と二袋の札を混ぜず、自分の商品の通常価格を見ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 味と一袋個数を確認し隣袋や二袋札と混ぜず通常価格で会計すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll verify flavor and one-bag quantity and take it to checkout. I won't mix the unbought neighboring bag or two-bag tag with my product's regular price.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm flavor and one bag, avoid confusing neighboring bags/two-bag tags and pay the product's regular price. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 一袋で承りました。必要な量でお選びください。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: One bag, understood. Choose the amount you need. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 散歩の行き先について、ご相談ですか。戻る予定は決まっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Consulting about a walk destination? Is the return plan set?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: あまり長く歩けないので、この案内の時間なら広場まで行って戻れると思いました。途中で休む時間も入れたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 長く歩けず案内の時間を広場往復の目安と思い途中休憩も希望すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I can't walk very long, and thought the time in this guide would let me reach the plaza and return. I'd like rest time along the way too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you cannot walk long, assumed the stated time covered the plaza return walk, and want a rest too. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この案内は広場まで片道の目安です。戻る時間や休憩まで含んだ約束ではありません。どの場所までがよさそうか図で比べましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: This is a one-way estimate to the plaza, not a promise including return and breaks. Let's compare suitable turnaround points on the map.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 往復込みだと思っていました。広場に着くことを優先せず、もっと手前で戻れる場所を探したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 目安を往復込みと誤解したため広場必達をやめ手前の折返しを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I thought it included returning. Rather than prioritizing reaching the plaza, I'd like a nearer turnaround.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain mistaking the estimate for round-trip time, give up insisting on the plaza and ask a nearer turnaround. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 入口寄りの花壇までにする案があります。花壇の手前にベンチの印がありますが、座席の空きはその時に確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: One option is the flowerbed nearer the entrance. A bench symbol is before it, but check seats at the time.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 空いていたら休み、空いていなければ無理に先へ歩いて次の席を探さないようにします。花壇で戻る道に階段はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 空席なら休み空席なしで先の席を探して無理に進まず花壇帰路の階段を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll rest if a seat is free; otherwise won't force myself onward looking for another. Are there stairs on the way back from the flowerbed?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you'll rest if free, won't press on seeking another seat if not, and ask about flowerbed-return stairs. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 図では、花壇から来た道を戻る案に階段の印はありません。現地の表示と足元も確かめてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: The map has no stair symbol on the plan returning the way you came. Check actual signs and footing too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 階段の印がないことだけで必ず楽とは考えず、歩いている途中でも戻ります。入口の目印を、この紙に書いてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 階段印なしを容易保証とせず途中帰還も考え入口目印を紙に書いてもらう。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I won't take no stair symbol as guaranteed ease, and may turn back partway. Could you write the entrance landmark on this paper?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Don't treat no-stair marking as guaranteed ease, consider early return and request the entrance landmark written down. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 入口の案内板を書き添えました。図の時間を自分にも必ず当てはまると考えず、ご自身のペースで判断してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: I've added the entrance information board. Don't assume map times always apply to you; judge at your pace.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 入口の案内板と花壇を目印に、手前の往復だけにします。片道の目安へ帰りと休憩を足して考え、疲れたら花壇まで行かず戻ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 入口案内板と花壇の短往復を選び片道目安に帰路休憩を含め疲れたら手前でも戻ると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll use the entrance board and flowerbed as landmarks for just the shorter return walk. I'll add return and rest to the one-way estimate, and if tired return before the flowerbed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Choose the short entrance-board/flowerbed return, account for return and breaks beyond the one-way estimate, and turn back early if tired. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: こちらの紙をお持ちください。今日は短い往復として、無理のない範囲でお過ごしください。いってらっしゃい。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46217-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Take this paper. Today make a short return walk within your limits. Enjoy your walk.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 経路の途中で待ち合わせをされるそうですね。どの駅で、どなたと合流するご予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: You'll meet someone en route. At which station, and whom?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 乗換駅で友人と会って、一緒に出かけます。この検索結果の乗換時間があれば、友人と会う時間も足りると思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 乗換駅で友人と会い一緒に出かけるため、検索の乗換時間で合流も足りると思ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'll meet a friend at the transfer station and go together. I thought the search result's transfer time was enough to meet them too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain meeting a friend at the transfer station to travel together, assuming the search's transfer time also covered meeting. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 検索の乗換時間が、待ち合わせまで含んでいるとは限りません。合流する場所はホームですか、それとも改札の外でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Search transfer time doesn't necessarily include meeting. Is the meeting point a platform or outside the gates?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 友人は改札の外の案内板で待つと言っています。検索の時間は、列車を降りて乗り換えるだけの時間だと気づいていませんでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 友人は改札外の案内板で待つと伝え、単なる乗換だけの時間と気づかなかったと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: They'll wait at the information board outside. I didn't realize the search time meant only getting off and changing trains.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say your friend waits at the board outside the gates and you hadn't realized the time was only a train transfer. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 改札の外へ出る場合は、移動時間と切符の扱いも別に確認します。ご友人に、待ち合わせ場所を変えられるか尋ねられますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: For going outside, we must check walking time and ticket treatment separately. Could you ask to change the meeting point?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 友人は切符をまだ買っていないので、外で会うほうがよいと返事が来ました。短い乗換時間に合わせてホームへ来てもらうのはやめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 友人は未購入のため改札外合流を希望すると伝え、短時間に合わせホームへ来てもらわないと決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: They replied they haven't bought a ticket, so prefer outside. I won't ask them to come onto the platform to fit a short transfer.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say your unticketed friend prefers outside and decide against asking them onto the platform to fit a short transfer. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: それなら、外で会う時間を取れる候補を調べましょう。目的地でのご予定には、動かせない開始時刻がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Then let's find options leaving time to meet outside. Is there an unchangeable start time at your destination?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 予約はしていないので、到着が少し遅くなっても構いません。最も早い経路より、改札外で落ち着いて合流できる候補を知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 目的地の予約はなく少し遅着でもよいので、最速より余裕ある改札外合流の候補を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: No reservation, so a little later is fine. I want options for calmly meeting outside rather than the fastest route.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say no destination reservation and slight delay is fine, and ask for relaxed outside-gate meeting options over speed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 移動と待ち合わせに余裕を持たせた候補を比較します。ただ、切符で途中の改札を出られるかは、購入条件を見て確認が必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll compare options allowing travel and meeting time. But whether your ticket permits exiting midway requires its purchase conditions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 友人には、使う列車が決まってから待ち合わせの時刻を伝えます。切符の条件も確認して、検索に出た短い乗換をそのまま約束しないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 列車と切符条件を確認後に友人へ時刻を伝え、短い検索乗換をそのまま約束しないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll tell my friend the meeting time after choosing trains. I'll check ticket conditions too and won't promise the search's short transfer as it stands.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you'll tell the time after checking train and ticket conditions, not promise the short search transfer unchanged. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、改札外での合流を含む相談として候補を確認します。お二人の待ち合わせ場所のメッセージを開いて、こちらでお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: We'll check options including meeting outside the gates. Open your meeting-place message and wait here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 証明書を二通ご希望とのことですが、提出先は同じところでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: You want two certificates. Are they for the same recipient?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 一通は部屋を借りるため、もう一通は会社に出します。同じ住所の証明なので、同じ内容を二枚取ればよいと思っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 住宅用と会社用の二通を同じ住所証明と思い、同じ内容でよいと考えたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: One for renting a room and one for work. Both prove the same address, so I thought two with identical contents would do.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain assuming identical contents for housing and work because both are address proof. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 提出先によって求める記載が違うことがあります。それぞれの案内はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Required details may differ by recipient. Do you have both sets of instructions?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 部屋の案内はこちらで、会社の案内は携帯にあります。片方には本人分、もう片方には世帯に関する言葉があり、同じではなさそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 住宅の紙と会社の携帯案内を示し、本人分と世帯の表現が異なると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Here is the room paper, and work's on my phone. One says self-only, the other mentions household; they don't seem identical.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show housing paper and company phone guidance, noting differing self-only and household wording. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この世帯の範囲と、必要な項目が不明なままでは決められません。提出先に確認できている内容はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: We can't decide with household scope and required details unclear. Anything already verified with the recipients?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 住所と名前が必要とは聞きましたが、世帯全員なのかや、省いてよい項目は聞いていません。一つの申請にまとめる前に分けて確かめたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 住所氏名は必要と聞いたが世帯範囲や省略項目は不明で、申請をまとめる前に分けて確かめたいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: They said address and name are needed, but I haven't asked all household members or omittable items. I'd like separate confirmation before combining applications.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say address/name are needed but household scope and omissions are unknown, and seek separate checks before combining. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 二つの提出先それぞれに、書類名と必要な範囲を確認してください。その後で、こちらで申請できる内容や確認書類をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Ask each recipient the document name and needed scope. Then we'll explain possible applications and verification documents here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 住宅の担当者と会社へ別々に聞きます。会社の返事を、住宅側にもそのまま当てはめてよいとは考えないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 住宅担当と会社へ別々に確認し、一方の回答を他方にも当てはめないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll ask housing staff and work separately, without assuming work's answer applies to housing too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you'll verify housing and work separately and not apply one answer to the other. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 回答をお持ちいただければ、申請する内容と部数を整理できます。同じものを先に二通発行してよいかは、まだ決めないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: With their answers we can organize contents and copies. Don't yet decide to issue two identical ones first.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日は二通分の申請を保留します。回答をそれぞれの案内にメモし、必要な記載と部数、費用を確かめてから申し込みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 二通の申請を保留し、回答を各案内に記録して記載事項・部数・費用確認後に申込むと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll defer both applications today. I'll note each answer on its instructions, then check details, copies and cost before applying.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Defer two applications, record answers with each instruction and apply after confirming details, quantity and cost. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、確認したい点を案内ごとに分けて控えましょう。申請書はまだ提出せず、回答後に改めてこちらへご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Let's note questions separately for each guide. Don't submit the application yet; consult us again after replies.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 問診票の「既往歴」の欄で、ご質問がありますか。いま何を書こうとなさっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Any question about medical history? What are you writing there?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 今の手首の痛みを書きました。既往歴も、今日いちばん困っている症状という意味でよいのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 既往歴欄に今の手首痛を書き、今日の主症状という意味でよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I wrote my current wrist pain. Does medical history mean the symptom troubling me most today?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you entered current wrist pain under medical history and ask whether it means today's main symptom. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 既往歴は、これまでにかかった病気やけがなどについて伺う欄です。今回の痛みは、症状の欄で分けてお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Medical history asks about past illnesses or injuries. Describe this pain separately in symptoms.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 昔、左腕を骨折したことがあります。今痛いのは右手首なので、古いけがと今回の症状を別に書きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 昔の左腕骨折と現在の右手首痛を別に記入したいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I broke my left arm long ago. The pain now is my right wrist, so I'd like to record old injury and current symptoms separately.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you'd like the old left-arm fracture and current right-wrist pain recorded separately. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その区別が分かるように記入しましょう。今回の右手首の痛みは、いつごろから、どんな時に感じますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Write clearly distinguishing them. Since when, and when do you feel this right-wrist pain?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 週末からで、買い物袋を持ち上げるときに痛みます。昔の骨折のせいかは自分では分からないので、原因と決めて書かないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 週末から袋を持ち上げる際に痛み、昔の骨折との関係は不明なので原因と断定しないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Since the weekend, when lifting shopping bags. I don't know whether the old fracture caused it, so won't write it as the cause.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain pain lifting bags since the weekend and unknown connection to the old fracture, without asserting a cause. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 原因については診察で医師にご相談ください。普段の薬や、今回の痛みで使用した物はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Discuss the cause with the doctor. Any usual medicine or anything used for this pain?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 普段使う薬はありません。昨日は市販の貼り薬を使いましたが、名前を覚えていません。外袋を家族に確かめてもらえます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 常用薬はなく昨日市販の貼り薬を使ったが名は不明で、家族に外袋を確認してもらえると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: No regular medicine. I used an over-the-counter medicated patch yesterday but don't remember the name. Family can check the outer packet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say no usual medication, used an unnamed OTC patch yesterday, and family can check packaging. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 使った物の名前が分かったら、診察で見せてください。不明なままなら、その点もお伝えいただけます。記入でほかに確かめたいことはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: If you learn the product name, show it at examination. If still unknown, say so. Anything else about filling the form?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 骨折した年が正確には分からないので、およその時期と書きたいです。貼った物も分からなければ不明と伝え、空欄だけにしないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 骨折年はおよその時期と書き、貼った物も不明ならその旨伝えて単なる空欄にしないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I don't know the fracture year exactly, so want to write an approximate period. If the patch stays unknown I'll say unknown rather than leave it simply blank.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say fracture year will be approximate, and unknown patch details will be stated instead of a bare blank. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 分かる範囲を記入し、不明な点はそのままお知らせください。問診票を確認して担当へ渡しますので、診察で詳しくお話しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Write what you know and tell us what you don't. We'll check the questionnaire and pass it to staff; explain fully at examination.
